gaps.lead: Delia said that she would no longer tolerate her colleagues being rude.
gaps.sentence: 'I am not willing ___ from my colleagues any longer,' said Delia.

gaps.lead: 'I'll definitely call you when I land,' she told me.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call; the person promised shifts to 'me'.

gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.

gaps.lead: Although the traffic was heavy, we reached the airport in time.
gaps.sentence: We reached the airport in time ___ traffic.
gaps.explanation: 'Although the traffic was heavy' becomes 'despite the heavy traffic' — despite + noun phrase.
